_note: version + hash are upstream's public wine-<version>.tar.xz from dl.winehq.org (hash = sha256-<base64 of the raw digest>, what fetchurl checks). fork_tag names the kasm/main tag in the private fork whose commits over wine-<version> are vendored as patches/ (git format-patch); the ledger for that tag is wine-assess/docs/wine-fork.md. On a fork move: regenerate patches/, bump version/fork_tag/hash together.
